name: timeatlas
title: Timeatlas
description: Notes and daily glance for Time Atlas.
author: shak

commands.name: add-note
commands.title: Add Note
commands.description: Write a note to the Time Atlas iCloud directory for any date.

commands.name: today-at-a-glance
commands.title: Today at a Glance
commands.description: In-window summary of today's sleep, places, distance, and notes from Time Atlas.

preferences.name: icloudPath
preferences.title: Time Atlas iCloud Folder
preferences.description: Optional override. Leave empty to use the default Time Atlas iCloud Documents folder.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` again.

" && exit 1
